findings.subject: Unsupported audience need
findings.evidence: independent-document.md / In plain words and Problem
findings.observation: The request names an unspecified new audience. The draft adds that they need to be addressed directly and that the existing text fails them. No supplied source establishes who the new audience is, its situation or that need.

findings.subject: Missing agreed operational outcome and measure
findings.evidence: independent-document.md / Success measures; native/work/native-report.md / Content readiness
findings.observation: The draft treats return of an adapted greeting and manual inspection as sufficient success. It does not report the missing owner-agreed operational outcome and measure; an unmeasured baseline does not supply either input.

findings.subject: Unsupported exclusions
findings.observation: Preserving the existing greeting behavior, excluding internationalisation, excluding dynamic personalisation and excluding operational monitoring are not agreed limits in the request. These choices may materially change what adapting the greeting means.

findings.subject: Incorrect completeness claim
findings.evidence: native/work/native-report.md / Content readiness and Content review; final visible response
findings.observation: The report marks all intent checklist items complete and claims no unsupported constraints. The final response also calls the draft complete. The required negative-case behavior is an incomplete draft or an exact missing-input blocker.

mechanical_results.failure_reporting: The observations command was used before the final report. Its zero-failure report agrees with the captured native events.
